s1: Walter is ninety-two. Three weeks ago he started a new medicine.
s2: Now his hands shake, and a rash is spreading. Forms are hard. He doesn't want his words sent anywhere. So he says nothing.
s3: His doctor gets ten minutes, every few months. How have you been? Fine. He's forgotten how he felt two months ago. So the months in between stay blank.
